# Notation Usage Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NotationUsageRole`](gmeow-NotationUsageRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NotationUsageRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The role a notation system plays in a specific usage — a value, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. Open-ended: new analytical frameworks may introduce further roles without ontology modification.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NotationUsageRole`](gmeow-NotationUsageRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the function a notation serves in a particular use — transcription, encoding, representation, communication, expression, shorthand, cipher — referenced from a [`NotationSystemUsage`](gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) via [`gmeow:notationUsageRole`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageRole.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-role subclasses (roles are individuals) and avoid using a role to record the system's domain kind — that is [`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md), an orthogonal axis (the same notation may play different roles in different usages).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded role individual from a [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) via [`gmeow:notationUsageRole`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageRole.md); add new individuals, not subclasses, when an analytical frame needs a finer role.
